Definition: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
BiblicalUsage: Gadol means great, and it is one of the largest words in the Bible, used nearly five hundred times. The LORD saved Israel by a great deliverance in 1 Chronicles 11:14, and Solomon made a great throne of ivory in 1 Kings 10:18. Samuel tells Israel to stand and see the great thing the LORD will do in 1 Samuel 12:16, and the covenant binds small and great alike in 2 Chronicles 15:13.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe great is a word that belongs to God first and to men second. The great deliverance, the great thing, the great throne — all of them point up to a greatness beyond our own. I hold that when we call anything great, we should ask whether it makes God look great.
RelatedTopics: God's glory; Majesty of God; Victory
